Challenge the assumed **250 Pro subscribers** first.

It was Olumi’s estimate, not a figure you supplied, and the analysis identified Pro subscriber count as the strongest driver of the comparison. It directly determines the immediate revenue gained from a £10 increase, so being materially above or below 250 changes the case for £59.

Second, challenge the assumed **3% monthly churn**—also Olumi’s estimate—because your under‑4% requirement was not actually testable in the run.
